name: top_fixed_of_iterate_contraction
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] (f : X → X) (n : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (hK : K < 1) (h : ∀ x y : X, dist (f^[n] x) (f^[n] y) ≤ K * dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f^[n] p = p) : f p = p
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] (f : X → X) (n : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (hK : K < 1) (h : ∀ x y : X, dist (f^[n] x) (f^[n] y) ≤ K * dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f^[n] p = p), f p = p
informal: If an iterate f^[n] is a contraction with fixed point p then p is already a fixed point of f — f p is also fixed by f^[n] (iterates commute with f) and a contraction with K < 1 has at most one fixed point.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] (f : X → X) (n : ℕ), ∀ K < 1, (∀ (x y : X), dist (f^[n] x) (f^[n] y) ≤ K * dist x y) → ∀ (p : X), f^[n] p = p → f p = p
